section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1993
title: ACCIDENTAL DEATHS & SUICIDES IN INDIA - 1993 N.C.R.B.- 5 1.1.2 The estimated annual growth of ‘Accidental Deaths’ at compound rate is 4.5 per cent while the statistics available shows a decline of 1.3 per cent in 1993 over the previous year. The main contributory factor for this decline has been substantial decrease to the tune of 5% in the ‘Accidental Deaths’ by un-natural causes. There was, however, a remarkable increase of 166 per cent in the ‘Accidental Deaths’ due to Natural causes in 1993, mainly due to the unfortunate calamity of earthquake in the ‘Latur’ and ‘Osmanabad’ districts of Maharashtra State during September 1993. The table below presents the distribution and percentage variation of ‘Accidental Deaths’ by Natural and Un-natural causes during the recent past.
